languages.text: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

text.formatted: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
text.plain: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

text.formatted: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
text.plain: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
